data.summary:
ESG consulting and delivery professional with 12+ years of cross-industry experience spanning GHG accounting, sustainability reporting, ESG SaaS implementation, and client-facing programme management. Proven record of leading end-to-end ESG solution delivery — from onboarding and framework alignment through KPI reporting and continuous improvement — for global energy, financial services, and supply chain clients. Deep expertise across GHG Protocol (Scope 1, 2, 3), ESRS, TCFD, GRI, BRSR, CDP, and SBTI. Experienced in managing multi-location data collection, configuring ESG calculation platforms (Sphere, Salesforce Net Zero Cloud), and mentoring specialist teams. ISO 14064-certified Lead Verifier/Validator.
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
▪ ESG SaaS Delivery: Led ESRS multi-platform implementation across Sphere, Smart Excel, and Salesforce Net Zero Cloud for a global oil major — boosting client satisfaction and reducing reporting effort significantly.
▪ GHG Data Quality: Improved GHG emissions data accuracy by 25% and reduced interpretation errors by 15% through redesigned SOPs and validation frameworks for institutional- grade ESG datasets.
▪ Decarbonization Strategy: Established SBTI-aligned reduction targets at Trafigura — achieving a verified 32% reduction in Scope 1 & 2 emissions and automating emission accounting by 50%, delivering INR 1.2 Cr programme two months ahead of schedule.
▪ Client & Stakeholder Management: Served as primary client contact for senior stakeholders across Business, IT, and Central Reporting for one of the world's largest global oil majors, managing delivery milestones and steering committee reporting.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
AI Champion & ESG Programme Manager | BlackRock (Sustainability Controller) — Mumbai Feb 2025 – Present ▪ Led end-to-end ESG and regulatory reporting transformation — migrated legacy GHG reporting infrastructure to Snowflake Data Cloud, governing full delivery lifecycle from discovery through UAT and go-live; reduced reporting turnaround time by 15%. Implemented Azure Document Intelligence API for intelligent document extraction, eliminating manual processing workflows and generating $60,000 in annual savings — established as a scalable onboarding pattern for future ESG data integrations. ▪ Served as primary point of contact and trusted advisor to senior finance and technology executives; developed executive Power
▪
BI dashboards linked to Snowflake for real-time ESG and regulatory visibility.
▪ Upskilled 50+ team members as divisional AI Champion — designed and delivered role-based training on GenAI tools and ESG
workflow automation, driving measurable productivity improvements and Copilot adoption.
▪ Managed escalation of critical delivery blockers, coordinating cross-functional engineering and support teams to resolve issues
with minimal business disruption.
Senior Consultant — Digital Sustainability & Programme Delivery | Infosys Consulting — Bangalore May 2023 – Jan 2025 ▪ Led ESG SaaS implementation and onboarding for ESRS regulatory reporting — requirements assessment, data mapping, and
platform configuration across Sphere, Smart Excel, and Salesforce Net Zero Cloud for a global oil major.
▪ Managed senior stakeholders across Business, IT, and Central Sustainability Reporting, aligning technical solution delivery with
regulatory compliance outcomes and steering committee milestone reporting.
▪ Designed innovative Scope 3 data architecture (Categories 3, 11, 15) adopted by the client's Central Reporting team — reducing
reporting effort and boosting client satisfaction; engagement scope subsequently extended.
▪ Governed delivery milestones maintained SLA-aligned reporting to steering committees, and drove cross-functional
accountability through defined deliverables and proactive risk management.
▪ Applied GHG Protocol, ESRS, and TCFD frameworks to advise on double materiality, boundary setting, and assurance readiness
— supporting client preparation for external third-party verification.
Data Quality Assurance Manager | Morningstar — Mumbai – Nov 2022 – May 2023 ▪ Led a team of 5 ESG data analysts in GHG emissions data quality assurance for institutional ESG datasets — improved data accuracy by 25% and reduced interpretation errors by 15% through redesigned SOPs and structured validation processes. ▪ Served as escalation point for client data queries and ESG ratings; drove continuous improvement in data management
technology and collection processes aligned to GHG Protocol standards.
Project Manager | Virtusa Consulting — Hyderabad – May 2022 – Nov 2022 ▪ Supervised the PMO for one of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies — directed Agile transformation of project
management processes and elevated client satisfaction by 15% through disciplined end-to-end delivery governance.
Senior Analyst — Digital Transformation & ESG | Trafigura Global Services — Mumbai Jul 2016 – Apr 2021 ▪ Led end-to-end decarbonization programme worth INR 1.2 Cr — automated Scope 1, 2, and 3 emission accounting by 50%, reduced reputational risk by 31%, and delivered two months ahead of schedule for a global commodity supply chain.
▪ Established SBTI-aligned global environmental reduction targets — achieved verified 32% reduction in Scope 1 & 2 emissions;
▪
designed and reported against CDP, TCFD, UN, and EITI disclosures as primary ESG reporting lead. Implemented Supplier Management System and digitized Due Diligence processes — reduced business risk by 30% through data-backed elimination of high-risk suppliers; acted as POC for UN, EITI, CDP, and media stakeholders.
Assistant Manager — EHS | Indian Oil Tanking Limited — Mumbai – Aug 2011 – Jul 2016 ▪
Implemented digital third-party risk assessment processes and drove operational improvements — achieved 10% reduction in incidents and 15% improvement in safety compliance.
SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager 6.0 (Jul 2024)
